findings.note: The rates lack operational evaluation definitions: e.g., denominator/label treatment for supported cases and top-candidate accuracy, the rule for identifying confident recommendations, and what makes an escalation applicable/correct. An approved labelled set alone does not ensure these metrics are reproducibly calculable; define the conventions before evaluation.

findings.section: FR-009; User Story 2, Acceptance Scenario 3; Edge Cases
findings.note: FR-009 requires duplicate/prior-allocation checks to be resolved but not deterministically. UC8 specifies deterministic duplicate and prior-allocation checks; without that observable requirement, a model-dependent result could permit inconsistent confidence decisions. Require a reproducible check outcome before confident allocation.

The checklist marks requirements unambiguous and success criteria measurable, but SC-001–SC-004 do not define evaluation denominators, label treatment, or escalation applicability. Revisit these checked items after metric conventions are specified.
